repos_data.description: IBAN validation API: bank code checked against national registers (DE, AT, BE, CZ, SK, BG, CH, LI), national check digits (FR, BE, IT, ES, UK), BIC resolved with its source, SEPA Instant and VoP readiness, bank-level sanctions (OFAC, EU, UN). 89 countries. REST API and MCP server.

Read ISO 20022 camt Bank-to-Customer Statements (camt.052/053/054) and generate validated reversing entries by return reason code such as AC04 Closed Account. Core library with a Click CLI and FastAPI REST API.
